The plate spans about 350 px across in the image. If it is a standard 26 cm dinner plate, that is roughly 13.5 px per cm.

The pizza slice measures about 190 px by 110 px, which is roughly 14 cm by 8 cm. It looks like a thick, focaccia-style or Roman slice about 1.5 cm high.

Its volume is about 14 × 8 × 1.5 ≈ 168 cm³. Bread-like pizza is airy and has a density of about 0.6 g/cm³, which gives roughly 100 g. A slice this size would more plausibly weigh around 110 g, so I'll use that.

I'll split it into crust and dough, cheese and sauce, and basil. The basil is only a few leaves, so it gets a small weight.
